claim_B.notes: Independent mandate/pool fixtures drove the production script as subprocesses. All requested assertions matched. Supplying served-effort medium does not bypass an absent pool effort. These are declaration checks, not proof of actual backend effort.

claim_C.notes: Seeded a scratch Shared Spine through its typed API, with a frozen requirement, admitted TaskSpec and created WorkOrder. Binding lookup confirmed sess-maker was the EXECUTE maker. Production controller subprocesses matched every requested assertion. The unbound read case takes the non-mutating early return; it does not establish binding-lookup behavior for unbound writes.

registry_sweep.notes: PLAN route reported without judgment, as instructed. Successful sweep process exit does not mean an empty fatal list.

disagreements: Registry integrity is not clean: the sweep returned a fatal codex_sha256 drift finding despite process exit success.
